brute_force.note: gap: the reference ban (best on half the replicates) minus the network's ban, both scored on the other half; a finite-budget reference that knows the lobby's hidden stand-ins, not oracle regret. The same-draw numbers are kept for comparison with v8.4 and are biased upward

world_model_uncertainty.varies: pick, outcome and ban models refitted on moving-block resamples; taste, preprocessing, calibration, selected families and the stand-in pool fixed
world_model_uncertainty.regret_note: each world's best ban picked on half its replicates and scored on the other half (v8.5), so the gaps are not selection noise

cohorts.note: never scored: reserved matches no earlier run scored, by stable game id; the bootstrap keeps the whole block's consecutive-match blocks
